description: Build the MediMo checkout link for a chosen clinic and treatment, so the person can complete their booking and payment on medimo.co.uk. Returns the URL and a summary of what they are booking and what it costs. Call it once they have chosen. It holds no appointment, creates no booking, takes no payment and needs no personal details — all of that happens on the MediMo page. Pass insurer for the insured checkout, which asks for their policy details. Safe to call more than once.

clinic_id.description: The clinic id from search_clinics or get_clinic.

insurer.description: Optional. The health insurer paying, e.g. "Bupa". Opens the insured checkout for that insurer. Use the same insurer passed to get_clinic.

practitioner_id.description: Optional. The practitioner id from get_clinic, if they asked for someone specific.

service_id.description: Optional. The service id from get_clinic, to open the checkout on that treatment.

starts_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 time, from get_availability next_available_at. Requires service_id and practitioner_id.

name: start_booking

checkout_url.description: Give this to the person. Booking and payment complete on medimo.co.uk.

insurer.description: The insurer the checkout is set up for. Absent for self-pay.

no_upfront_payment.description: Present and true when the insurer is billed and nothing is taken at checkout.

price_gbp.description: What the patient pays at checkout. With an insurer, that insurer's price.

treatment_included.description: Present and false only when the clinic states this appointment is assessment only.

data_as_of.description: Age of the underlying reading, when different from generated_at.

generated_at.description: When this response was produced. ISO 8601, Europe/London.

title: Start a booking
